title: What advice do therapists at Pinnacle Blooms Network give to parents with children starting occupational therapy?
metaTitle: Advice for Parents Starting Occupational Therapy | Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Learn about the advice therapists at Pinnacle Blooms Network provide to parents with children starting occupational therapy.
html: Patience and perseverance are key elements for parents starting their child's journey in occupational therapy at Pinnacle Blooms Network. Progress may take time and can vary for each child. Celebrating each minor victory is encouraging not just for your child, but also for you as a parent. Always remember, every child has their own rhythm and path of development and we are here to guide and support at every step of this journey.
